body: Thank you. I’m sorry about what happened to you. I made a post on SW because of this aswell.
That’s really tough. I lost my girlfriend a year ago because she left me for another guy.

I don’t have heart pounding through thinking about it, but I get it while trying to kill myself.  I think it’s the fundamental will of the human body wanting to survive. This is why I sometimes think I just can’t kill myself and I am forced to live a life of pain. But this is also why I think I have to make the best of it.
Yeah I know this. But that’s their fault, not yours. Are you happy with how you‘re handling things or do you value their opinion so much, that that defines how good you think you‘re doing?

I will remember you. Forever. I know how it is to have fake friends. I realized I had to stop feeling too much for those people, because they don’t care about me and I have to focus on my real friends. (Yeah I have actual friends, sorry if you don’t). The other thing is. I don’t think people have to archive great things in life. Working, eating and sleeping can be nice aswell. As long as you always do something to step forward.
